sections.title: Writing structures
sections.tests: Turning a name or a description into the right structure: substitution pattern, ring fusion and numbering, charges, tautomer.
sections.hexsketch: validate_structure and the readback on every drawing: unreadable SMILES, atoms over their valence, aromatic rings that cannot be kekulized, and the name and formula to compare with what was meant.

sections.title: Reading structures
sections.tests: Working from a drawn structure: its IUPAC name, molecular formula, exact mass or molecular weight, and what it is.
sections.hexsketch: read_sketcher gives the model the drawing as SMILES; name_structure and analyze_structure give the name, formula, masses and isotope pattern.

sections.title: Stereochemistry
sections.tests: Assigning and drawing R/S and E/Z, enantiomers and diastereomers, meso compounds, telling two drawings apart.
sections.hexsketch: SMILES with explicit stereocentres, names with their descriptors, and compare_structures for the same compound and the same stereoisomer.

sections.title: Reactions
sections.tests: The product of a drawn scheme: regio- and chemoselectivity, what the reagents over the arrow do, atom balance, several steps in sequence.
sections.hexsketch: Reactions as schemes with reagents above and conditions below the arrow, structures checked, and the atom balance of each step.

sections.title: Mechanisms
sections.tests: The intermediates of a mechanism in order, with their charges.
sections.hexsketch: Mechanisms as steps on one page with curly arrows, every intermediate drawn and checked, map numbers kept from step to step.

sections.title: Synthesis
sections.tests: Retrosynthetic disconnections to starting materials, and forward routes with the intermediates in order.
sections.hexsketch: Retrosynthesis and synthesis as one scheme, disconnections marked on the target, every intermediate checked and the route's atoms balanced.

sections.title: Protecting groups and peptides
sections.tests: Protected compounds written in full (Boc, Fmoc, TBS, Bn...), and peptides from their sequence with every stereocentre.
sections.hexsketch: Protecting groups drawn abbreviated while names, formulas and checks see every atom; peptides drawn from the SMILES with their configuration.

sections.title: Safety
sections.tests: Recognising energetic groups, highly toxic or pyrophoric compounds and hazardous reagent combinations from the structures.
sections.hexsketch: Hazard screening on every structure and reagent: energetic groups with their oxygen balance, toxic and reactive compounds, dangerous combinations.
